followup_explanation:
This query is a source-based explanation task — extraction and synthesis from provided primary sources and a video clip into a structured paragraph. That's squarely an extraction/retrieval and summarization task.

Looking at the capabilities:
- Whimbrel-235B scores higher on Extraction & Retrieval (81.6 vs 78.5), which is the dominant skill needed here — pulling evidence from sources and tying it to specific historical questions.
- On Summarization the two are effectively tied (80.3 vs 79.9, within variance).
- Willet's edge is in Creative Generation (81.2 vs 78.8) and Support Dialogue, neither of which is the core demand of this task.

The roughly 3-point Extraction & Retrieval advantage is meaningful (above the 2.0 variance threshold) and matches exactly what this query needs, so Whimbrel is the better fit. The warm, friendly tone of the request didn't drive the decision — it's just a benign academic question — so the task preference profiles weren't a deciding factor here.
